subject.title: improve(matrix): prove lifecycle parity across substrates

question: Should the Matrix QA lifecycle helpers be exposed through extensions/qa-matrix/test-api.ts as a durable test-only cross-extension surface for qa-lab and future QA lanes?
rationale: The code path follows the current owner boundary, but automated review should not decide whether this new package-root test API becomes a compatibility surface.

options.title: Accept the test API
options.body: Merge with extensions/qa-matrix/test-api.ts as the supported test-only import path for shared Matrix lifecycle helpers.

options.title: Keep helpers private
options.body: Remove or narrow the package-root test API and keep the lifecycle helpers local until a broader Matrix QA test surface is explicitly needed.

recommendation.title: Accept the test API
recommendation.body: Merge with extensions/qa-matrix/test-api.ts as the supported test-only import path for shared Matrix lifecycle helpers.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the linked issue, the PR head, and recent Matrix QA work, so they are the clearest owner to confirm the intended test API shape.
